sentence: Add a new staff member in Mega-Net EHR Cloud.
You need the Org Admin role.
You will open Staff Directory, fill in a short form, and save.
Other roles do not see Staff Directory in the menu.
Open the menu, and choose Staff Directory.
The list shows everyone in your organization, with their role, facility, and status.
Use the filter box to find someone.
Below the list is the Add or Edit Staff form.
Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
Type the first name, the last name, and the email address.
Each email address can belong to only one account.
Now choose a role.
The roles are Org Admin, Physician, Nurse, Front Desk, Billing Clerk, Lab Technician, Pharmacist, and Inventory Manager.
Then choose a facility from your organization's list.
There is no password field.
You never choose or see a password.
Choose Save.
A message confirms the invite, and the new person appears in the list.
The form keeps their details.
To add someone else, choose Clear first.
If something is wrong, Save tells you what to fix.
For example, a missing or invalid email address.
An email that another account already uses is refused.
To recap: open Staff Directory, fill in the form, and choose Save.
That is how you add a staff member.
